name: Optimized Ray-Box Distance for Parallel Projections
aliases: Distance Computation for Entry and Exit Points
definition: An optimization for calculating the distance $d$ between ray entry and exit points in a node's bounding box, avoiding the expensive Euclidean distance formula by exploiting parallel projection properties.
summary: Optimized Ray-Box Distance for Parallel Projections calculates entry-exit distances in axis-aligned bounding boxes without square roots, using direction cosines and octree levels for faster interactive volume rendering.
